posts.body:
By the time your baby is able to roll, or even wriggle, especially if swaddled, the moses basket will probably be too small anyway. My kids were all out of the moses basket by 3months. 

Plenty to stress about being a parent, I dont think putting the moses basket inside the crib shoud be added to the list.

The other great option to a Moses basket is a sleepyhead, at Tiny Footprints. They can go in the crib, in your bed as a safe co-sleeper, a lot of people also travel with them so baby has a bed on the plane and also (more importantly!) at the other end.
